citation: Data from Comparitech Ransomware Intelligence Platform (ransomware.comparitech.com)

by_reason.description: The source row had no organisation name and no usable content, a spacer or a formatting artefact in the spreadsheet.

The strain cell named more than one group in a single string, and the combination did not resolve to groups this platform already knows. Attributing the incident would mean choosing between readings of a compound name, so it is excluded and counted here rather than filed under a guess.
The date cell could not be read as a month. We do not guess a date for a row we cannot date.
The country cell named a place that did not resolve to an ISO 3166-1 country. Rather than file the incident under a guess, it is excluded and counted here.
